newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz bids for outstanding Hermes stock.
newsitem.headline: Allianz bids for outstanding Hermes stock.

text.p: German insurance giant Allianz AG on Tuesday offered to buy up outstanding shares in the Hermes Kreditversicherungs AG loan insurance company, which it already controls, at 385 marks per share.

In a newspaper announcement, the group said the offer would run from January 20 through March 20. In a separate announcement, Allianz-controlled Vereinte Holding made an offer for remaining shares in Vereinte Versicherungs AG.

Allianz said last July it would seek the remaining shares in Hermes and the Vereinte Versicherungs AG group when it gained control of both in a complicated share swap deal with reinsurance group Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG.
Both advertisements appeared in the Tuesday edition of the Handelsblatt daily newspaper.
Allianz said its offer for Hermes represented a premium of 30 percent on the price Hermes shares were trading before the takeover was announced last July.
On their home Hamburg stock exchange, Hermes stock last traded on Friday and closed at 380 marks.
Allianz said that Hermes management board had been informed of the offer and considered it reasonable.

Vereinte, whose offer also runs January 20 through March 20, said it was offering Vereinte Versicherungs AG shareholders a 20 percent premium on the price at which their stock traded before the takeover plans were revealed.
The management board of Vereinte Versicherungs AG was recommending that shareholders avail themselves of the offer, the announcement said.

Vereinte is offering 2,850 marks per bearer share with a par value of 100 marks, 1,050 marks for registered shares with par value of 50 marks and 2,100 marks per registered share with par value of 100 marks.
These prices were already made known at the time of Allianz's takeover of Vereinte, when it said just two percent of the company's stock was still held by small shareholders.
The takeover gave Allianz a 75.3 percent stake in Hermes, in which it already owned 25 percent.
